WITH henley_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*`, UNNEST(hits) AS hit, UNNEST(hit.product) AS prod
  WHERE prod.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
)
SELECT p.v2ProductName AS product_name, SUM(COALESCE(p.productQuantity, 0)) AS total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` s
JOIN henley_buyers hb ON s.fullVisitorId = hb.fullVisitorId
, UNNEST(s.hits) AS hit
, UNNEST(hit.product) AS p
WHERE p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
  AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews,
    SAFE_CAST(totals.transactions AS INT64) as transactions,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
      WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(h.product) AS p WHERE p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS INT64) > 0)
    ) as has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as session_month,
    pageviews,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND has_product_revenue THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND NOT has_product_revenue THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_type
  FROM session_data
  WHERE (transactions >= 1 AND has_product_revenue) OR (transactions IS NULL AND NOT has_product_revenue)
)
SELECT 
  session_month,
  session_type,
  AVG(pageviews) as avg_pageviews_per_visitor
FROM classified
GROUP BY session_month, session_type
ORDER BY session_month, session_type

WITH inpatient_avg AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_inpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
),
outpatient_avg AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_outpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
)
SELECT 
  i.provider_id,
  i.provider_name,
  ROUND(i.avg_inpatient_payment, 2) as avg_inpatient_payment,
  ROUND(o.avg_outpatient_payment, 2) as avg_outpatient_payment,
  ROUND(i.avg_inpatient_payment + o.avg_outpatient_payment, 2) as combined_avg_cost
FROM inpatient_avg i
LEFT JOIN outpatient_avg o ON i.provider_id = o.provider_id
ORDER BY combined_avg_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT nppes_provider_state, 
       SUM(total_claim_count) as total_claim_count, 
       SUM(total_drug_cost) as total_drug_cost
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE drug_name = 'AMLODIPINE BESYLATE'
GROUP BY nppes_provider_state
ORDER BY total_claim_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH RECURSIVE icd10_desc AS (
  SELECT 1569798 as ancestor_id, concept_id_2 as descendant_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 1569798 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.ancestor_id, cr.concept_id_2
  FROM icd10_desc d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
    ON d.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
icd10_all AS (
  SELECT 1569798 as ancestor_id, 1569798 as descendant_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM icd10_desc
),
atopic_desc AS (
  SELECT 1569765 as ancestor_id, concept_id_2 as descendant_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 1569765 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.ancestor_id, cr.concept_id_2
  FROM atopic_desc d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
    ON d.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
atopic_all AS (
  SELECT 1569765 as ancestor_id, 1569765 as descendant_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM atopic_desc
),
psoriasis_desc AS (
  SELECT 1569777 as ancestor_id, concept_id_2 as descendant_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 1569777 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.ancestor_id, cr.concept_id_2
  FROM psoriasis_desc d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
    ON d.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
psoriasis_all AS (
  SELECT 1569777 as ancestor_id, 1569777 as descendant_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM psoriasis_desc
),
vitiligo_desc AS (
  SELECT 35208655 as ancestor_id, concept_id_2 as descendant_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 = 35208655 AND relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.ancestor_id, cr.concept_id_2
  FROM vitiligo_desc d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
    ON d.descendant_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
),
vitiligo_all AS (
  SELECT 35208655 as ancestor_id, 35208655 as descendant_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ancestor_id, descendant_id FROM vitiligo_desc
),
icd10_concepts AS (
  SELECT 'L70' as code, 'Acne' as name, descendant_id as concept_id FROM icd10_all WHERE ancestor_id = 1569798
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L20', 'Atopic dermatitis', descendant_id FROM atopic_all WHERE ancestor_id = 1569765
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L40', 'Psoriasis', descendant_id FROM psoriasis_all WHERE ancestor_id = 1569777
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L80', 'Vitiligo', descendant_id FROM vitiligo_all WHERE ancestor_id = 35208655
),
snomed_concepts AS (
  SELECT 'L70' as code, 'Acne' as name, descendant_concept_id as concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 141095
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L20', 'Atopic dermatitis', descendant_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 133834
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L40', 'Psoriasis', descendant_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 140168
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'L80', 'Vitiligo', descendant_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 138502
),
all_concepts AS (
  SELECT * FROM icd10_concepts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM snomed_concepts
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) as total FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
),
counts AS (
  SELECT ac.code, ac.name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) as cnt
  FROM all_concepts ac
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence` co
    ON ac.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  GROUP BY ac.code, ac.name
)
SELECT c.code, c.name, c.cnt, t.total, SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cnt, t.total) * 100 as percentage
FROM counts c
JOIN total t ON TRUE
ORDER BY c.code

WITH all_years AS (
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, air_temperature, wetbulb_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, sea_surface_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
  WHERE air_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL
    AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    year, 
    month, 
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air_temp,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wet_bulb,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dewpoint,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM all_years
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
  year,
  month,
  avg_air_temp,
  avg_wet_bulb,
  avg_dewpoint,
  avg_sst,
  ABS(avg_air_temp - avg_wet_bulb) + ABS(avg_air_temp - avg_dewpoint) + ABS(avg_air_temp - avg_sst) 
  + ABS(avg_wet_bulb - avg_dewpoint) + ABS(avg_wet_bulb - avg_sst) 
  + ABS(avg_dewpoint - avg_sst) as sum_abs_diff
FROM monthly_avgs
ORDER BY sum_abs_diff
LIMIT 3

WITH daily_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) AS temp_f,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) AS prcp_in
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' 
    AND year = '2019' 
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
    AND SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) != 9999.9
    AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
    AND SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) != 99.99
),
converted AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    ROUND((temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(wdsp_knots * 0.514444, 1) AS wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(prcp_in * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm
  FROM daily_data
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    wdsp_ms,
    prcp_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wdsp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8
  FROM converted
),
with_lags AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    wdsp_ms,
    prcp_cm,
    temp_ma8,
    wdsp_ma8,
    prcp_ma8,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag1,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag2,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag3,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag4,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag5,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag6,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag7,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag8,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag1,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag2,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag3,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag4,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag5,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag6,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag7,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag8,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag1,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag2,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag3,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag4,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag5,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag6,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag7,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag8
  FROM with_ma
)
SELECT 
  date,
  ROUND(temp_c, 1) AS temp_c,
  ROUND(wdsp_ms, 1) AS wdsp_ms,
  ROUND(prcp_cm, 1) AS prcp_cm,
  ROUND(temp_ma8, 1) AS temp_ma8,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8, 1) AS wdsp_ma8,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8, 1) AS prcp_ma8,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag1, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag1,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag2, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag2,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag3, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag3,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag4, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag4,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag5, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag5,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag6, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag6,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag7, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag7,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag8, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag8,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag1, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag1,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag2, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag2,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag3, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag3,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag4, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag4,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag5, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag5,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag6, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag6,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag7, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag7,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag8, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag8,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag1, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag1,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag2, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag2,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag3, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag3,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag4, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag4,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag5, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag5,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag6, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag6,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag7, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag7,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag8, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag8
FROM with_lags
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 5 OFFSET 77

-- Get the highest PRCP, min TMIN, max TMAX for each year in the last 15 days
-- Last 15 days = Dec 17-31
SELECT 
  CAST(SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value / 10.0 END) AS max_precipitation_mm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value / 10.0 END) AS min_temperature_c,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value / 10.0 END) AS max_temperature_c
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2013' AND '2016'
  AND date >= DATE_SUB(DATE(CONCAT(_TABLE_SUFFIX, '-12-31')), INTERVAL 14 DAY)
  AND date <= DATE(CONCAT(_TABLE_SUFFIX, '-12-31'))
  AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMIN', 'TMAX')
  AND value IS NOT NULL
  AND qflag IS NULL
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH species_tree AS (
    SELECT UPPER(species_scientific_name) as upper_scientific, fall_color
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`
),
count_1995 AS (
    SELECT 
        UPPER(spc_latin) as upper_spc,
        COUNT(*) as cnt_not_dead
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
    WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL 
      AND spc_latin NOT IN ('UNKNOWN LIVE TREES', 'UNKNOWN DEAD TREES', 'UNKNOWN STUMP', 'PLANTING SITE')
      AND status != 'Dead'
    GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
count_2015 AS (
    SELECT 
        UPPER(spc_latin) as upper_spc,
        COUNT(*) as cnt_alive
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
    WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
      AND status = 'Alive'
    GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        st.upper_scientific,
        st.fall_color,
        COALESCE(c19.cnt_not_dead, 0) as cnt_1995,
        COALESCE(c21.cnt_alive, 0) as cnt_2015,
        COALESCE(c21.cnt_alive, 0) - COALESCE(c19.cnt_not_dead, 0) as diff
    FROM species_tree st
    LEFT JOIN count_1995 c19 ON st.upper_scientific = c19.upper_spc
    LEFT JOIN count_2015 c21 ON st.upper_scientific = c21.upper_spc
    WHERE COALESCE(c19.cnt_not_dead, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(c21.cnt_alive, 0) > 0
)
SELECT 
    fall_color,
    SUM(cnt_1995) as total_1995_not_dead,
    SUM(cnt_2015) as total_2015_alive,
    SUM(diff) as total_change,
    COUNT(*) as num_species
FROM species_diff
GROUP BY fall_color
ORDER BY fall_color

SELECT 
  p_zone.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
  d_zone.zone_name AS dropoff_zone,
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS trip_duration_seconds,
  t.trip_distance * 3600.0 / SAFE_CAST(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS FLOAT64) AS driving_speed_mph,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount * 100.0, t.total_amount) AS tip_rate_pct
FROM (
  SELECT 
    vendor_id,
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    extra,
    mta_tax,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    airport_fee,
    total_amount,
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01' 
    AND pickup_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND dropoff_datetime >= '2016-07-01'
    AND dropoff_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND fare_amount >= 0
    AND extra >= 0
    AND mta_tax >= 0
    AND tip_amount >= 0
    AND tolls_amount >= 0
    AND total_amount >= 0
    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    vendor_id,
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    extra,
    mta_tax,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    airport_fee,
    total_amount,
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_green_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01' 
    AND pickup_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND dropoff_datetime >= '2016-07-01'
    AND dropoff_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND fare_amount >= 0
    AND extra >= 0
    AND mta_tax >= 0
    AND tip_amount >= 0
    AND tolls_amount >= 0
    AND total_amount >= 0
    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
) t
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` p_zone 
  ON t.pickup_location_id = p_zone.zone_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` d_zone 
  ON t.dropoff_location_id = d_zone.zone_id
ORDER BY t.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT year FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population` WHERE country_name IN ('United States', 'France', 'China', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Germany', 'Iran') AND indicator_name LIKE '%population%' LIMIT 20

SELECT 
    TRIM(co.county_name) as county_name,
    co.state,
    c.median_age,
    CAST(c.total_pop AS INT64) as total_population,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(co._2020_08_27 * 100000.0, c.total_pop), 2) as cases_per_100k,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(d._2020_08_27 * 100000.0, c.total_pop), 2) as deaths_per_100k,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(d._2020_08_27 * 100.0, co._2020_08_27), 2) as case_fatality_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2020_5yr` c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.confirmed_cases` co ON c.geo_id = co.county_fips_code

-- Calculate total chi-squared statistic
WITH paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_uuid, bcr_patient_barcode
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
  WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
patient_mutations AS (
  SELECT 
    p.bcr_patient_uuid,
    p.bcr_patient_barcode,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients p
  LEFT JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` m
    ON p.bcr_patient_barcode = m.ParticipantBarcode 
    AND m.Study = 'PAAD'
  GROUP BY p.bcr_patient_uuid, p.bcr_patient_barcode
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    has_kras,
    has_tp53,
    COUNT(*) as observed
  FROM patient_mutations
  GROUP BY has_kras, has_tp53
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(observed) as grand_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_pos_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_neg_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_pos_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_neg_total
  FROM contingency
)
SELECT 
  SUM(
    POW(c.observed - 
      CASE 
        WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_pos_total * m.tp53_pos_total, m.grand_total)
        WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_pos_total * m.tp53_neg_total, m.grand_total)
        WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_neg_total * m.tp53_pos_total, m.grand_total)
        WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_neg_total * m.tp53_neg_total, m.grand_total)
      END, 2) / 
    CASE 
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_pos_total * m.tp53_pos_total, m.grand_total)
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_pos_total * m.tp53_neg_total, m.grand_total)
      WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_neg_total * m.tp53_pos_total, m.grand_total)
      WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_neg_total * m.tp53_neg_total, m.grand_total)
    END
  ) as chi_squared_statistic
FROM contingency c
CROSS JOIN margins m

WITH mitelman_cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.CaseNo, c.RefNo
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` c
  WHERE c.Morph = '3111' AND c.Topo = '0401'
),
mitelman_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN c.Chr = 'chrX' THEN 'X'
      WHEN c.Chr = 'chrY' THEN 'Y'
      ELSE REPLACE(c.Chr, 'chr', '')
    END as Chromosome,
    c.Type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mc.CaseNo) as num_cases
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
  INNER JOIN mitelman_cases mc ON c.RefNo = mc.RefNo AND c.CaseNo = mc.CaseNo
  GROUP BY Chromosome, c.Type
),
recurrent_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    CASE 
      WHEN Abnormality LIKE '+%' THEN 'Gain'
      WHEN Abnormality LIKE '-%' THEN 'Loss'
    END as Type,
    CAST(TotalCases AS INT64) as num_cases
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT m.Chromosome, m.Type, m.num_cases as mitelman_freq, r.num_cases as recurrent_freq
  FROM mitelman_freq m
  INNER JOIN recurrent_freq r ON m.Chromosome = r.Chromosome AND m.Type = r.Type
  WHERE m.num_cases >= 5 AND r.num_cases >= 5
)
SELECT 
  Type as aberration_type,
  CORR(mitelman_freq, recurrent_freq) as pearson_correlation,
  COUNT(*) as num_chromosomes
FROM combined
GROUP BY Type

  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
all_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM dec_events
),
user_pageviews AS (
  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    COUNT(*) AS pageview_count
  FROM dec_events
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
purchasers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM dec_events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
),
user_pageviews_full AS (
  SELECT
    au.user_pseudo_id,
    COALESCE(up.pageview_count, 0) AS pageview_count
  FROM all_users au
  LEFT JOIN user_pageviews up ON au.user_pseudo_id = up.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN upf.user_pseudo_id IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM purchasers) THEN upf.pageview_count END) AS avg_pageviews_purchasers,
  AVG(CASE WHEN upf.user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM purchasers) THEN upf.pageview_count END) AS avg_pageviews_non_purchasers,
  AVG(CASE WHEN upf.user_pseudo_id IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM purchasers) THEN upf.pageview_count END) 
  - AVG(CASE WHEN upf.user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM purchasers) THEN upf.pageview_count END) AS avg_difference
FROM user_pageviews_full upf

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    param.value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
    page_params.value.string_value AS page_title
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS param
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(event_params) AS page_params ON page_params.key = 'page_title'
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '20210102'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
session_flags AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN page_title = 'Home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visited_home,
    MAX(CASE WHEN page_title = 'Checkout Confirmation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visited_checkout
  FROM page_views
  WHERE page_title = 'Home' OR page_title = 'Checkout Confirmation'
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN page_title = 'Home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
)
SELECT 
  COUNTIF(visited_checkout = 1) AS sessions_with_checkout,
  COUNT(*) AS sessions_with_home,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(visited_checkout = 1), COUNT(*)) * 100 AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM session_flags

WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    SAFE_CAST((SELECT ep.value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) ep WHERE ep.key = 'ga_session_id') AS STRING) AS ga_session_id,
    (SELECT ep.value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) ep WHERE ep.key = 'session_engaged') AS session_engaged
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
distinct_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id, MAX(session_engaged) AS is_engaged
  FROM session_data
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id
),
engaged_sessions_per_user AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    COUNTIF(is_engaged = '1') AS engaged_session_count
  FROM distinct_sessions
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(engaged_session_count) AS avg_engaged_sessions_per_user
FROM engaged_sessions_per_user

WITH session_params AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'source' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS source,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'medium' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS medium,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'campaign' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS campaign
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS ga_session_id,
      ep
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`, UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
      AND ep.key IN ('source', 'medium', 'campaign')
  )
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex') 
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|.*ppc.*|.*paid.*') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|\^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|.*ppc.*|.*retargeting.*|.*paid.*') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'.*badoo.*|.*facebook.*|.*fb.*|.*instagram.*|.*linkedin.*|.*pinterest.*|.*tiktok.*|.*twitter.*|.*whatsapp.*')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|.*ppc.*|.*retargeting.*|.*paid.*') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|.*ppc.*|.*retargeting.*|.*paid.*') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'cross-network') THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'push$|mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') 
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*video.*') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|\^)shop|shopping).*)$') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'.*badoo.*|.*facebook.*|.*fb.*|.*instagram.*|.*linkedin.*|.*pinterest.*|.*tiktok.*|.*twitter.*|.*whatsapp.*')
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM session_params
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions
FROM classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC

-- Final clean query with formatted output
WITH session_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
first_quickplay_period AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_name as quickplay_event_type,
    event_date as first_quickplay_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) as rn
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'
    AND event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
),
fq AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, quickplay_event_type, first_quickplay_date
  FROM first_quickplay_period
  WHERE rn = 1
),
retention_check AS (
  SELECT 
    fq.user_pseudo_id,
    fq.quickplay_event_type,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
      WHERE e.user_pseudo_id = fq.user_pseudo_id
        AND e.event_date = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_ADD(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fq.first_quickplay_date), INTERVAL 14 DAY))
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
  FROM fq
  INNER JOIN session_users su ON fq.user_pseudo_id = su.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  quickplay_event_type,
  COUNT(*) as total_users,
  SUM(retained) as retained_users,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained), COUNT(*)), 4) as retention_rate
FROM retention_check
GROUP BY quickplay_event_type
ORDER BY total_users DESC
